Project Assistant: Bachelor's degree in science / 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for C-MET Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.cmet.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the C-MET Recruitment 2026 is 16 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced for the Research Associate (RA)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Project Assistant posts in the Centre for Materials for Electronics Technology (C-MET) recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the C-MET Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) post is ₹58,000/- per month, plus HRA and 1 month basic towards medical expenses.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is a Bachelor's degree in B.Tech/B.E. in relevant engineering fields or a Master's degree in Physics/Electronics or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the C-MET Recruitment 2026, as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Project Assistant posts is 28 years. Specific age limits are also provided for other posts like RA and JRF/Project Associate.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the C-MET Recruitment 2026 is based on an Interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for C-MET Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification for C-MET Recruitment 2026 can be found on the official website of C-MET, www.cmet.gov.in. A link to the PDF is also provided in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the recruited positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the recruited positions in the C-MET Recruitment 2026 is contractual.
